reviews.comment: There are 10 small writing assignments, only about a paragraph, so they were very easy. One group project and 3 exams on canvas which are all open note and one other individual assignment where you cook something and write about it. Overall an interesting class and an easy A, he also posts his power points on canvas so if you miss a zoom it's okay.
The professor wants you to get a good grade in his class, the only thing I did not enjoy was at times I thought it got a bit political in lectures.

Easy grader with free tests. This was a zoom class that I was expecting to not pay a single lick of attention to, however, I actually found a bit of it interesting. He would tell interesting stories about himself to where I started paying attention about 30% of the time. I never dreaded being in his class. Great guy.

This class only have 3 exams, a group project, and a couple in class participation questions. He posts the in-class question before class starts so you know there's going to be one. The group project was super easy and used as a grade booster. The exams were also open note and super easy as well. Really nice prof that loves what he's teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I took this class and didn't really expect much but I LOVE this professor and found the topics we covered very interesting. The professor cares about us learning and truly wants to connect with his students and overall the assignments are held during class but they're not hard at all. 10/10

The lectures were 3 times a week and I probably went to class about 8 times. The assignments are very easy and interesting. The tests are word for word from his powerpoints and the textbook. Hes a very caring guy and if you interact in class, you will get a lot out of it but you can also just get through by doing the assignments only.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. La Pastina cares about the content he teaches and cares more about the students. Tests are centered around the lectures (I didn't use the textbook at all), and they were open notes. He is friendly and open to discussion. One group project counted for 10% of the grade. Highly recommend - it is an easy A if you pay attention in class.
